modmenu.descriptionTranslation.litematic: High-performance Litematica companion mod adding smart auto-placement, accurate block rotation resolution, and inventory buffer caching for Fabric.
litematica_printer_pro.title: Litematica Printer Pro
litematica_printer_pro.config.printer_en: Toggle automatic schematic block placement on or off.
litematica_printer_pro.config.placement_: Maximum spherical distance in blocks from the player within which blocks will be auto-placed.
litematica_printer_pro.config.blocks_per: Maximum number of blocks placed in a single client game tick (1-20).
litematica_printer_pro.config.placement_: Tick delay between successive placement burst executions.
litematica_printer_pro.config.smart_rota: Calculates exact hit vectors and player angles for directional blocks (stairs, slabs, observers, pistons, hoppers).
litematica_printer_pro.config.carpet_acc: Encodes block facing and properties into the interaction packet hit vector using Carpet/Masa protocol.
litematica_printer_pro.config.inventory_: Fast-swap needed items into the hotbar from main inventory and shulker box cache.
litematica_printer_pro.config.break_wron: Automatically breaks incorrectly placed or obstructing blocks if enabled.
litematica_printer_pro.config.strict_ray: Enforces that the placement face has a direct visible line of sight from the camera.
litematica_printer_pro.config.show_hud.c: Displays placement speed, queue depth, and printer status on screen.
litematica_printer_pro.config.tune_noteb: Automatically tune placed note blocks to match schematic pitch.
